notes: HONEST PARTIAL across two dispatches. Dispatch 1 (pre-policy): fit arithmetic before authoring showed FFT64 could not meet the then-current 8x8 caps; quarantined with an executable wall test. Owner then declared a CHIP-SCALE BLOCK CLASS (sole-occupant transform blocks may use the full panel; perimeter-channel reservation and D4 rotation waived; the ONLY contract is I/O reachable from the x16 ports). Dispatch 2 built that class and re-derived the budget from the real CellProgramResolver (same accounting reproduces FFT16's measured 44): FFT64 = 81 cells needing 12 rows vs 11 available (worst stage s0 = 23 vs a 20-cell band); FFT128 = 110 cells needing 14 rows - exactly the available area with zero slack, ruled out single-die by arithmetic. TWO CORRECTIONS to the earlier estimate, both load-bearing: (a) the octant fold costs 9 cells not 5 - the prior note charged an explicitly 'unattainable' lower bound, and an unattainable bound is not a budget; all six pairwise merges bust the 32-word budget; (b) stages can never share or split 2-row bands (verified against FFT16's shipped 4-band layout), hiding 2 rows. SHIPPED AND GATED (37 tests): CHIP_SCALE flag + layout_caps() (declaring classes get the full panel; every other block still asserted at (8,8) - not a global loosening) with CHIP_SCALE_ORIENTATIONS making the rotation waiver explicit; octant-fold twiddle math bit-exact at both N in the landed 4-way form AND a cell-shaped factorisation (swap = o0 XOR o1, c sign = o1, d always negative) incl. the strided N=128 stage-1 case and both trivial encodings, with INV-4 negatives; the whole fold chain simulated cell-by-cell reproducing every shipped stage_table word; all cells within 32 words, state pinned; m==0 proven unreachable so the fold needs no saturating combine. NOT DONE, stated plainly: no chip ever ran an FFT64/128 - no on-chip bit-exactness, SNR, port-reachability, GRC binding, saturation or orientation gates, all blocked on placement. Construction raises LargeFFTGeometryError with the exact shortfall rather than emitting a silently-unroutable layout. Cell-shaving measured insufficient (~1 cell vs a 3-cell shortfall). REMAINING MECHANISMS, neither built: a 4-row band with a feedback transit column (costs 2 more rows), or the 2-die stage-boundary split (the authorized N=128 fallback; correctly not reached for before the N=64 question was settled). EMPIRICAL FINDING: the router accepts a landing cell on the x16_in port cell (FFT16 at (0,0) routes and runs), but anchor choice is routability-sensitive in non-obvious ways ((3,0) fails where (0,0) and (2,0) succeed) - hence gating the class contract on a real built chip.
